channel.title: Hippo updates
channel.description: Stable and opt-in beta updates for Hippo.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.0
item.description:
# Hippo 1.0.0
First public release with built-in updates.
- Check for updates from the Hippo menu or Settings → Updates. - Automatic update checks, with installation kept out of active recordings. - Optional beta updates for testing upcoming releases before Stable. - Sidebar icons and selection highlights follow your chosen accent, with readable selected text. - A wider, top-aligned meeting timeline with pinned speaker names and scrolling. - A more prominent “Check again” button in the live meeting’s People tab. - DeepSeek removed from meeting summary and fallback choices; Ollama remains available for local models. Existing DeepSeek summary selections move to Apple on-device.
Requires Apple silicon and macOS 26 or later. Developer ID signed and Apple notarized.
Existing users: install this release manually once to enable future in-app updates.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.1
item.description:
Improves Today’s Brief and meeting review workflows. Brief suggestions now have a separate persistent checklist; Action Items and Timeline views have clearer controls and accessibility descriptions; the Home and Known Voices views are easier to scan.
Requires macOS 26 or later. Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.1
item.description:
Action Items now adapts its controls to the available window width. Wider views use a compact header; narrower views keep the title and controls readable and provide all scopes in a menu.
Requires macOS 26 or later. Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.1
item.description:
Fixes Action Items checkboxes so clicking anywhere inside the square toggles completion, including the empty center of an unchecked box.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.1
item.description:
## What's new
- Added an automatic write-up delay setting. Choose a delay from 1 to 1,440 minutes in Settings → When. - Delayed write-ups resume when Hippo next opens if the app is closed at the deadline. - Choosing “Only when I ask” cancels scheduled write-ups. Existing immediate behavior remains the default.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.2
item.description:
## What's new
- Collapse the sidebar into a compact icon rail while keeping every section within reach. - Open Meetings from the rail to search recent meetings or browse your full meeting history. - Your collapsed-sidebar preference is remembered when Hippo restarts. - Navigate the rail and meeting picker with the keyboard, including Command-F search and Escape to close.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.3
item.description:
## Fixed
- Sidebar labels no longer remain stuck after selecting a section. - Keyboard-focus labels dismiss automatically while keyboard navigation and normal hover tooltips remain available.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.4
item.description:
## What's new
- Hippo adopts the Liquid Glass design language: translucent cards, a glass live-meeting bar, glass tab pills and buttons, and a system window background. - Chat bubbles, text fields and the collapsed sidebar rail follow the new look. - Collapsed sidebar: hovering an icon shows its name and hides it when you move away. The heavy focus box around clicked icons is gone.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.5
item.description:
## What's new
- Action item checkboxes highlight under your pointer. Ticking one shows the check mark briefly before the item leaves the list (Action Items and Home). - Confirmation and notice pop-ups now use your chosen accent color instead of the system accent.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.6
item.description:
## What's new
- Fixes voices being matched to people who weren't on the call. On Teams and Zoom, Hippo now only recognizes people on the participant list, and double-checks each recognized voice against that meeting's own audio before keeping the name or learning from it. - If a voice can't be confirmed, it's left unnamed so you can name it, instead of guessing.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.7
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.7 (beta)
### Speaker naming - **Smarter suggestions.** Hippo ranks the likely person for each unnamed voice and pre-selects the closest match with a one-tap "Yes" button. - **"Likely" hints.** When someone introduces themselves or is addressed ("Dana here", "thanks, Priya"), Hippo suggests that name. Nothing is ever named without your click. - **Your own voice is left out** of the candidates for the other side of a call. - **Safer learning.** Fixed a bug where naming a voice that was matched to the wrong person could rename someone else's saved voice. - **Fewer skipped voices.** Voices that the end-of-call check rejected are now asked about instead of being silently dropped. - **Steadier naming list.** The "Who is this?" list keeps everyone seen on the call, and a background refresh no longer cancels your Refresh.
### Pop-out windows - Open any past meeting in its own window to read its write-up, notes and transcript while you're on another call. - Right-click a meeting and choose **Open in New Window**, or use the button in the meeting header. Pop-outs are read-only.
### Speaker re-check from the recording (off by default) - After a call, Hippo can re-analyze the full recording and propose speaker corrections for you to review, apply, or undo. - Turn it on in **Settings → Transcription → Second pass**. It needs **Keep meeting audio** on, downloads an extra model the first time, and can use noticeable CPU for a few minutes.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.8
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.8 (beta)
### Meetings sidebar - **Pop-out icon on every meeting.** Hover a meeting in the sidebar, or select it, and an "Open in New Window" icon appears at the right edge of the row. One click opens that meeting's write-up, notes and transcript in its own read-only window. - The row's title fades out under the icon, so it never overlaps the text, and the icon sits in the same place on every row.
### Release notes - Update notes now show headings and bullet points in the update window instead of a single block of text.
Includes everything in 1.0.7: smarter speaker naming, read-only pop-out windows, and the optional post-call speaker re-check.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.9
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.9 (beta)
### Voices are named automatically after a call - **Auto-naming.** When a call ends, Hippo matches voices it couldn't name live against your library and names the clear matches for you. In testing on past meetings, most of the speech that stayed unnamed sounded clearly like someone Hippo already knew. - **You stay in control.** An **Auto-named N voices from your library** banner appears above the transcript, with **Review**, **Undo** and **Keep**. Undo puts everything back, one voice at a time or all at once, and never touches lines you've edited. - **Weaker matches become suggestions.** Anything less certain shows up as a pre-selected "Yes" in the naming sheet. Nothing else is ever named without your click. - **Fragments are joined.** A person Hippo split into several voices is merged back into one. - **Turn it off** in **Settings → Transcription → Second pass → Name voices automatically after a call**, if you'd rather only get suggestions.
### Recognition is more reliable - A person who isn't on the participant list is no longer dropped when their voice clearly matches someone you know well. - Two saved voices for the same person no longer cancel each other out. - Confirming a name now teaches the voice from that meeting, and voices improve gradually instead of being overwritten by the latest call. - Hippo never mistakes a colleague who shares your first name for you.
### For the curious - Each meeting now saves a short **why it was or wasn't recognized** report next to it, to help tune recognition.
Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple silicon. This is a beta: please check the first few auto-named calls and tell us if a name looks wrong.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.10
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.10 (beta)
- Today's Brief: Hippo now confirms Copilot is in front before pasting the prompt, so it no longer pastes into the wrong app. - If Hippo can't drive Copilot, it leaves the prompt on your clipboard and notifies you to press ⌘V in Copilot.

item.title: Hippo 1.0.11
item.description:
## Hippo 1.0.11 (beta)
- Today's Brief: fixes runs that timed out with "Copilot started but hadn't published its window" — Hippo now makes Copilot expose its message box so the prompt can be pasted and sent. - If Copilot still can't be driven, Hippo leaves the prompt on your clipboard and notifies you to press ⌘V in Copilot.
